BIOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BIOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell Structure and Specialisation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cell Structure and Specialisation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cell Structure and Specialisation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell Structure and Specialisation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cell Structure and Specialisation.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transport? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Transport.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transport.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transport.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transport.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Specimen Collection and Preservation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Specimen Collection and Preservation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Specimen Collection and Preservation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Specimen Collection and Preservation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Specimen Collection and Preservation.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Biology? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Biology.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Biology.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Biology.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Biology.

7. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

9. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri.

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.

13. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Gaseous Exchange and Respiration? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Gaseous Exchange and Respiration.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Gaseous Exchange and Respiration.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Gaseous Exchange and Respiration.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Gaseous Exchange and Respiration.

15. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

16. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Nutrition and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Transport and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Gaseous Exchange and Respiration Total Number of Lessons Page 15 of 44 1 STRAND  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Gaseous Exchange and Respiration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Biology 1.2 Specimen Collection and Preservation 1.3 Cell Struct and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Biology and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
